title: Hotel cannot find your reservation: what to do now
dek: Check the property, dates, guest name and booking references. If you booked through a third party, get them involved before paying twice.
metaDescription: Hotel cannot find your booking? Check names and confirmation numbers, contact the booking site, and document tonight's options before paying twice.

sources.name: Hilton Help Centre: third-party reservations
sources.note: Hilton directs guests to the original third party to confirm, modify or cancel such reservations. This is a brand-specific example, not a universal hotel policy.

paragraphs: If the hotel cannot find your reservation, first confirm the exact property, arrival date, lead guest name and both the booking-site reference and hotel confirmation number. Show the original confirmation. If it was booked through a third party, contact that provider through its verified support route while asking the desk what can be established locally.

You are at the counter, the bags are heavy, and your phone says confirmed while the desk says nothing is there. The immediate job is to find out whether the booking can be located and where you can stay tonight. You do not need to settle every refund question before taking the next useful step.

This is a practical troubleshooting guide, not a guarantee of a room, compensation or a refund. Policies and legal rights depend on the booking, provider and jurisdiction. Keep the evidence and check the terms rather than accepting a generic promise from this article.

body.heading: Check the details that can actually change the search
items: Match the full property name and street address. A chain name alone is not enough, especially near airports or in cities with several branches.
Check arrival and departure dates, including a booking made for the night before a very early arrival. Ask whether the reservation was marked as a no-show or cancelled.
Read the lead guest name exactly as shown on the confirmation, including another person's surname or the person who made the booking.
Distinguish the travel site's order reference from a hotel confirmation number. Ask the desk which reference its system can search.
Check whether the message confirms accommodation or only an enquiry, payment attempt or request. Look for changes and cancellation messages as well as the first email.

body.heading: The same stay can have different references
rows: The property or brand reservation team
Can you search this reference for these dates and the lead guest name?
The provider you used to book
Can you supply the hotel's reference and confirm that the booking was transmitted?
The relevant payment provider or merchant
Is this a completed charge, a pending hold or something else?
The sender and the original booking provider
Which version of the reservation is current, and what happened to the original?

body.heading: If the hotel cannot find a third-party booking
paragraphs: Contact the company you booked with using its app, original confirmation or verified website. Do not use an unverified support number supplied in a random search result or message. Ask the provider to contact the property, verify the booking status and give you the hotel-side confirmation reference.

For a concrete policy example, [Hilton directs third-party customers](https://www.hilton.com/en-gb/help-center/reservations/can-i-book-through-a-third-party-site/) back to that provider for confirmation, changes and cancellation. Another brand or contract may work differently. The useful principle is to identify which party controls your booking, not assume the front desk can change a travel site's order.

Ask for a case reference, the person's name or department and the next promised action. If possible, ask support to speak with the property directly while you remain available. A screenshot of a confirmation is helpful evidence, but it is not proof that the desk can create a room or override inventory.

body.heading: Use the counter conversation to move the problem forward

items.line: My confirmation is for this property and these dates, under this guest name. I also have a booking-site reference. Which hotel confirmation number or other detail would help you search?
I am at the property and the desk cannot locate the stay. Can you confirm its current status, supply the hotel's reference and contact the property directly? Please give me a case reference.
What options can you confirm for tonight, and what costs or conditions apply? Please put any cancellation, replacement or reimbursement arrangement in writing before I rely on it.

body.heading: Before you pay for another room
paragraphs: If you need somewhere safe to stay, practical constraints may require a new booking. Before paying where possible, ask the original provider what it is authorising and what remains unresolved. A verbal promise that someone will sort it out later is not the same as a written commitment to cover a particular cost.

Check the new room's full price, taxes, deposit and cancellation terms. Keep the original reservation evidence and the new receipt. Do not assume a pending card hold is a second completed charge, or that a charge disappearing means a booking is valid. Your issuer can explain the transaction status and any dispute process or deadline that applies.

If you are travelling with children, have access needs, or are arriving late with limited transport, tell the desk and provider what makes a proposed alternative unsuitable. This is information they need to assess an option; it does not create a universal entitlement to a specific replacement.

body.heading: A booking that was there under another name
paragraphs: An invented example: Alex arrives with a confirmation for the right property, but the desk's first search uses Alex's surname. The lead guest on the booking is Alex's partner. Searching the lead guest name and hotel reference finds it. That is one possible cause, not a reason to blame the traveller or assume every missing booking is a spelling problem.

In a different case the provider cannot establish the booking and the hotel is full. The useful record then becomes the provider's case number, the property's confirmation of what it found, the agreed next step and any replacement costs. Keep the two situations distinct: locating a valid stay and negotiating an unresolved booking are different jobs.

body.heading: When the confirmation is not enough

items.q: Does a confirmation email guarantee that the hotel has a room for me?
items.a: It is important evidence of what was booked, but it does not resolve every issue with dates, cancellation, transmission or available inventory. Compare the exact property, guest and dates, then ask the responsible provider to confirm current status. Keep the email while the parties investigate rather than treating it as a complete answer.

items.q: Should I cancel the original reservation myself?
items.a: Not automatically. Ask the provider what cancellation would do to the existing case and any refund or replacement arrangements. If you choose to cancel, save the terms, confirmation and reason. Do not assume that cancelling a booking you cannot locate is required or harmless in every contract.

items.q: Can the front desk refund a booking made on another website?
items.a: It depends on who collected the money and the booking terms. The property may not control the travel site's payment or order. Ask both parties who can make the change and request written next steps. A brand-specific support policy is not a universal rule for every booking platform.

body.heading: Give the next conversation a starting point
paragraphs: Once tonight is sorted, keep the case trail together. Our [one-page itinerary guide](/guides/how-to-write-a-one-page-trip-itinerary) helps put each stay's address, dates and references within reach. For a disrupted connection, use the separate [flight-delay guide](/guides/flight-delayed-with-a-connection-what-to-do-first).

[Travel Companion](/shop/travel-companion) is an optional place for the travel details you enter. It does not locate a missing booking, contact a hotel or guarantee a refund. The free worksheet here can carry the same practical references without a purchase.
